Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

ResumeToken.description: Opaque, community-minted position in one caller's event stream. A console MUST NOT parse, construct or order it; it only hands the latest one back as `since` when it re-subscribes. A community binds it to the caller it was minted for and treats a token minted for anyone else as unknown.
ResumeToken.title: ResumeToken

Topic.description: One kind of change a console can be told about. A closed set: a topic not listed here is a new MINOR version of this component, not an `ext` member, because each topic is bound to the read that authorizes it.
Topic.title: Topic

schema.description: One hint, sent by a Verifiable Trust Community down an administrator console's live channel: something under `topic` changed, re-read it. It never carries the record that changed. Fire-and-forget: there is no response. The outer document members (id, type, issuer, recipient, issuedAt, expiresAt, proof) are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

count.description: Only on a count topic (`actions`, `acknowledgements`, `joinRequests`): the caller's current count for that topic as of `observedAt` — what a console badge shows. Absent on every other topic. A console MAY show it until its re-fetch returns, and MUST prefer the read's own count once it does.

observedAt.description: When the community observed the change. Where it coalesced several changes into this hint, the latest of them.

resumeToken.description: The stream position after this hint. A console keeps the latest one and passes it back as `since` when it re-subscribes.

topic.description: What changed. Always one of the effective topics the subscribe response named.

schema.title: VTC Admin Events — Event — payload
